pacing.note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent: term-by-term pacing is set by each member school within the CAPS scope. The referenced CAPS file's topic list is the content universe; its DBE week placements and SBA task list do NOT bind IEB schools - the SAG's programme of assessment does (see ../exam_guidelines/sag_index.json).

scope_deltas.rule: Record here only differences the official SAG itself states relative to the CAPS/DBE prescription (paper composition, topics assessed differently, optional content). Transcribe from the fetched SAG PDF only; an empty list means 'not yet transcribed', never 'no differences'.
